title: Rest in Christ
definition: Rest in Christ is the believer's trustful relief from striving, condemnation, anxiety, and self-salvation through the finished work and gentle care of Jesus.
summary: Christ gives rest to weary souls who come to Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is gentle and lowly in heart, giving rest to those burdened by sin and weakness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Rest in Christ describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is christ gives rest to weary souls who come to him.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Rest in Christ teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let rest in christ shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
